title: Стоп-лист: мои ошибки
fixTask: Фраза из твоего текста. Найди ошибку и исправь её прямо в тексте.
intro: Здесь твои реальные ошибки из уроков — фразы из твоих текстов. Сюда же будут попадать ошибки из эссе и надиктовок.
**actual** — ложный друг: увидел — остановись и проверь. «Нынешний, актуальный» = **current**.
**I** — всегда с заглавной. **Опечатки** — главная зона потерь на письменном IELTS: вычитывай перед отправкой.
Простой рассказ по порядку — **Past Simple** в активе: _we drove_, а не _we had been driven_.
**on time** — вовремя, по графику; **in time** — успеть впритык.

a: Last year I took a road trip to Abkhazia.
items.x: I всегда с заглавной — в любом месте предложения.

items.q: I joined the team in April, and i have been working on the project ever since.
a: I joined the team in April, and I have been working on the project ever since.

The next country, the final destination, was Switzerland.

items.x: lose — lost — lost, формы losed нет. Результат сейчас → Present Perfect.

items.x: Три ошибки в одной: droven нет (drive — drove — driven); ты вёл сам — актив; события по порядку — Past Simple.

title: Ложные друзья
intro: **actual** — реальный, фактический. «Актуальный, нынешний» = **current**. **actually** — «на самом деле» — у тебя верно.
**sympathetic** — сочувствующий (симпатичный = _nice, attractive_). **accurate** — точный (аккуратный = _neat, tidy_). **magazine** — журнал (магазин = _shop, store_).
Добавил для архитектора: «объект» = _site, building, project_; «эксплуатация» = _operation_; «экспертиза» = _design review_; «кабинет» = _office_.

items.x: actual = фактический — здесь как раз верно.

title: 1. Неправильные глаголы
intro: Из уроков: **lose — lost — lost, drive — drove — driven, find — found — found, buy — bought — bought, take — took — taken, go — went — gone, see — saw — seen**. _lose_ (терять) ≠ _loose_ (свободный).

Для архитектора добавил: **build — built — built, draw — drew — drawn, lead — led — led, choose — chose — chosen, write — wrote — written, oversee — oversaw — overseen, overcome — overcame — overcome**.
Вторая форма — Past Simple (_yesterday I **drove**_), третья — Perfect и пассив (_I have **driven**, it was **built**_).

title: 2. Present Simple и Present Continuous
intro: **Present Simple** — факты, привычки, расписание: _I work in Tbilisi. The office opens at 9._ Маркеры: _always, usually, often, every day_.
**Present Continuous** — происходит сейчас или в этот период: _I'm working on the Monaco project this month._ Маркеры: _now, at the moment, currently, these days_.
**Глаголы состояния** обычно не ставятся в -ing: _know, like, want, need, believe, understand, belong, seem_. _I know_, а не _I'm knowing_.
Вопросы и отрицания в Present Simple — с **do / does**: _Does she work here? He doesn't drive._ В 3-м лице ед. ч. — окончание **-s**.

a: He doesn't like working at weekends.

a: The construction sector is growing fast this year.

title: 3. Present Perfect vs Past Simple
intro: **Past Simple** — действие закончилось в закрытом времени: _yesterday, last week, in 2019, two years ago, when I was a child_.
**Present Perfect** — результат важен сейчас или опыт без даты: _just, already, yet, ever, never, so far, recently_.
**Present Perfect** с _for / since_ — началось в прошлом и продолжается: _I've lived here since 2019_.
**Present Perfect Continuous** — подчёркивает процесс и длительность: _How long have you been waiting?_
Вопрос с **when** — всегда Past Simple: _When did you arrive?_

items.x: since + продолжается до сих пор → Present Perfect.

items.x: Опыт без указания времени → Present Perfect. has been = ездила и вернулась; has gone = уехала и ещё там.

title: 4. Прошедшие времена в повествовании
intro: **Past Simple** — цепочка событий по порядку: _He came in, sat down and opened the letter_.
**Past Continuous** — фон или процесс, который прервали: _I was watching TV when the phone rang_.
**Past Perfect** — случилось раньше другого события в прошлом; маркеры _by the time, after, before, already_: _The film had started by the time we arrived_.
**Past Perfect Continuous** — процесс до момента в прошлом, часто как причина: _She was tired because she had been working all day_.
**used to** — прошлая привычка или состояние, которых больше нет.

title: 5. Способы говорить о будущем
intro: **will** — решение в момент речи, обещание, прогноз-мнение: _I'll get it. I think it will rain_.
**going to** — намерение (решение уже принято) или прогноз по видимым признакам: _Look at the clouds — it's going to rain_.
**Present Continuous** — договорённость с временем и местом: _I'm meeting Tom at 5_.
**Present Simple** — расписание: _The train leaves at 6.45_.
После **when, if, as soon as, until, before** — настоящее время, не will: _I'll call you when I arrive_.
**Future Continuous** — процесс в момент в будущем; **Future Perfect** — завершится к сроку: _by Friday, by 2030_.

items.q: Look at those clouds! It ___.
items.x: Прогноз по видимым признакам → going to.

items.q: I'll call you when I ___ (arrive).
items.x: После when — Present Simple, не will.

items.q: If it will rain tomorrow, we will stay at home.
a: If it rains tomorrow, we will stay at home.

items.q: — The phone's ringing. — I ___ get it.
items.x: Спонтанное решение в момент речи → will.

a: We're having dinner with Anna on Friday.

items.q: The train ___ (leave) at 6.45 tomorrow morning.
By 2030 the company ___ 50 offices.

title: 6. Условные предложения
intro: **Zero** — всегда так: _If you heat ice, it melts._ If + Present, Present.
**First** — реальное будущее: _If it rains, we'll cancel the site visit._ If + Present, will. После if — не will!
**Second** — нереально сейчас или маловероятно: _If I had more time, I would travel more._ If + Past, would. _If I were you…_
**Third** — нереальное прошлое: _If we had started earlier, we would have finished on time._ If + Past Perfect, would have + V3.
**Mixed** — условие в прошлом, результат сейчас: _If I had studied abroad, I would be working in London now._
**unless** = if not; **in case** — на случай, если; **as long as** — при условии, что.

items.q: If you heat ice, it ___ (melt).
If it ___ (rain) tomorrow, we'll cancel the site visit.
items.x: First: после if — Present, не will.

items.q: If I ___ more time, I would learn Spanish.
If I ___ (be) you, I would accept the offer.
items.x: If I were you — устойчивая фраза для совета; was допустимо в разговоре.

items.q: If we had started earlier, we ___ (finish) on time.
If she ___ the email, she would have replied.

a: If it is sunny, we will go to the beach.

a: Unless you hurry, you'll miss the train.

items.q: If you mix blue and yellow, you ___ green.

items.x: Инверсия Had I known = If I had known (C1, из твоего теста).

title: 7. Модальные глаголы
intro: **Обязанность**: _must_ (правило, внутреннее), _have to_ (внешняя необходимость). **Не обязательно** — _don't have to_. **Запрещено** — _mustn't_.
**Совет**: _should, ought to_. **Возможность**: _can, could, may, might_.
**Вывод о настоящем**: _must_ — наверняка, _can't_ — точно нет, _might / may / could_ — возможно: _He must be at the site._
**Вывод о прошлом**: _must have / can't have / might have + V3_: _She must have left early._
**Упрёк, сожаление**: _should have + V3_ — следовало (но не сделали): _We should have checked the drawings._
После модального — глагол без to: _must go_, а не _must to go_. В прошлом must → **had to**; после другого глагола can → **be able to**.

items.q: You ___ wear a helmet on the construction site — it's the rule.
You ___ come to the meeting if you're busy — it's optional.
items.x: Не обязательно → don't have to. mustn't = запрещено.

items.q: You ___ smoke inside the building.
You must to check the drawings before sending them.
a: You must check the drawings before sending them.

items.q: He's been working for 12 hours. He ___ (быть) exhausted.
items.x: Уверенный вывод о настоящем → must be.

items.q: That ___ be Anna — she's on holiday in Spain.
The lights are off. They ___ (leave) already.
items.x: Вывод о прошлом → must have + V3.

items.q: We ___ (check) the drawings more carefully — now we have to redo them.
items.x: Упрёк о прошлом → should have + V3.

items.q: I'm not sure where he is. He ___ be in the canteen.
You look tired. You ___ take a break.
items.x: Совет → should (ought to тоже, но с to).

items.q: When I was young, I ___ run 10 km easily.
In the future, I'd like to ___ (смочь) speak English fluently.
items.x: После другого глагола can не ставится → be able to.

items.q: She can't have finish the model yesterday — it's huge.
a: She can't have finished the model yesterday — it's huge.

items.q: Yesterday I ___ stay late because of the deadline.
___ I open the window?
items.x: Просьба разрешения: Can / Could / May I…?

a: We might have to postpone the site visit.

items.q: He ___ have called — I didn't hear the phone.
items.x: Не уверен о прошлом → might have + V3.

a: You mustn't leave your bags here — it's forbidden.

items.q: In my opinion, governments ___ invest more in public transport.
items.x: Для эссе IELTS: мнение через should.

title: 8. Пассив и актив
intro: **Пассив → актив**: исполнитель из _by…_ становится подлежащим, **время сохраняется** как было.
_The report **had been finished** by me_ → _I **had finished** the report._
_we drove_ — вели сами; _we were driven_ — нас везли. Когда рассказываешь о себе, обычно нужен актив.
Зато в IELTS Writing Task 1 (описание процесса) пассив — основной: _The concrete **is poured** into the formwork._

items.q: The design was created by our team. → Our team ___ the design.
items.x: was created → created: время то же, Past Simple.

items.q: The car was driven by my brother the whole way. → My brother ___ the car the whole way.
The drawings had been checked before the deadline. → The engineer ___ the drawings before the deadline.
The walls are being built by the contractor. → The contractor ___ the walls.
The model has been updated by Anna. → Anna ___ the model.
The facade will be approved by the city. → The city ___ the facade.
The site is cleaned by the workers every evening. → The workers ___ the site every evening.
I didn't drive — my brother did. I ___ all the way to Switzerland.

items.x: Описание процесса в IELTS Task 1 — Present Simple Passive.

items.q: Then the formwork ___ (remove) after seven days.
Bricks ___ (make) by hand until the 19th century.
The Tomsk centre ___ (deliver) on time despite all the problems.
The new school was build in 2020.
a: The new school was built in 2020.
items.x: В пассиве нужна третья форма: build — built — built.

a: The drawings will be sent to the client tomorrow.

items.q: When the inspectors arrived, the foundation ___.
items.x: Раньше их прихода + фундамент сам себя не заливает → Past Perfect Passive.

title: 9. Косвенная речь и wish
intro: **Косвенная речь**: после _said / told_ время сдвигается назад: Present Simple → Past Simple, Present Perfect и Past Simple → **Past Perfect**, will → **would**, can → **could**.
_«I sent it»_ → _He said he **had sent** it._ _«I'll call»_ → _She said she **would** call._
Слова времени тоже сдвигаются: _yesterday → the day before, last week → the previous week, tomorrow → the next day_.
**wish о прошлом** (жалею, что было или не было): _wish + Past Perfect_ — _I wish I **had studied** harder._
**wish о настоящем** (хочу, чтобы сейчас было иначе): _wish + Past Simple_ — _I wish I **had** more time. I wish I **were** taller._

items.q: She told me she ___ (finish) the project the previous week.
items.x: finished → had finished; last week → the previous week.

items.q: I wish I ___ (not / spend) so much money on that trip.
items.x: Сожаление о прошлом → wish + Past Perfect.

items.q: They said they ___ (never / be) to Georgia before.
items.x: have never been → had never been.

items.q: I wish I ___ (study) English earlier in my life.
The manager said the client ___ (approve) the concept.
«I'll send the drawings tomorrow.» → He said he ___ send the drawings the next day.
items.x: will → would; tomorrow → the next day.

items.q: «I can finish the model by Friday.» → She said she ___ finish the model by Friday.
«I work in Tbilisi.» → He said he ___ (work) in Tbilisi.
«We are designing a new school.» → They said they ___ (design) a new school.

items.x: the day before — событие раньше момента, когда она говорила → Past Perfect.

items.q: I wish I ___ that job offer two years ago.
items.x: two years ago — о прошлом → wish + Past Perfect. have accepted — частая ошибка.

items.q: I wish I ___ more free time these days.
I wish I ___ better at public speaking.
items.x: wish о настоящем: were для всех лиц (в разговоре допустимо was).

items.q: She said she will call me later.
a: She said she would call me later.

items.q: I wish I have left my previous job earlier.
a: I wish I had left my previous job earlier.
items.x: Твоя фраза из урока: wish о прошлом → had left.

items.q: «I have never seen such a mess in a BIM model.» → He said he ___ (never / see) such a mess.

a: She said she had already sent the report.

title: 10. Герундий и инфинитив
intro: **-ing после**: _enjoy, avoid, finish, suggest, mind, consider, keep, practise, look forward to_ и после **предлогов**: _interested in designing, good at sketching_.
**to + глагол после**: _want, decide, plan, hope, manage, agree, refuse, promise, afford, need, would like_.

**Меняют смысл**: _stop doing_ — перестать, _stop to do_ — остановиться, чтобы сделать; _remember doing_ — помнить, как было, _remember to do_ — не забыть сделать; _try doing_ — попробовать как способ, _try to do_ — пытаться.
В роли подлежащего — **-ing**: _Learning English takes time._

title: 11. Придаточные: who, which, that, whose, where
intro: **who** — о людях, **which** — о вещах, **that** — о людях и вещах (в уточняющих), **whose** — чей, **where** — где, **when** — когда, **what** — то, что.
**Уточняющее** (без запятых) — без него непонятно, о ком речь: _The architect who designed it is Italian._ Если слово — дополнение, его можно опустить: _The house (that) we built_.
**Дополнительное** (с запятыми) — просто добавляет информацию: _Tbilisi, which is the capital of Georgia, is growing fast._ Здесь **нельзя** that и нельзя опустить слово.

a: Tbilisi, which is the capital of Georgia, is growing fast.

items.x: Можно which или вообще опустить: The project I'm working on…

items.q: I like people which are honest.
a: I like people who are honest.

title: 12. Сравнение: степени и конструкции
intro: Короткие прилагательные: **-er / the -est**: _cheaper, the cheapest_. Длинные: **more / the most**: _more expensive, the most expensive_.
Исключения: _good — better — the best, bad — worse — the worst, far — further — the furthest_.
**as … as** — такой же, как: _as tall as_; **not as … as** — не такой, как.
Усиление: **much / far / a lot** + сравнительная степень: _far better_ (не _very better_). «Чем больше…, тем…» — _the more…, the more…_
Для IELTS Task 1: _twice as high as, slightly higher, significantly lower_.

items.q: The new office is ___ (big) than the old one.
This is the ___ (expensive) flat in the building.
The roads in Europe were ___ than in Abkhazia.
This option is more cheaper than the first one.
a: This option is cheaper than the first one.

items.q: Our office is not as ___ (modern) as theirs.
The second design is ___ better than the first.
items.x: Усиление сравнительной — much / far / a lot, не very.

items.q: This is the ___ day of my life!
Traffic today is worse then yesterday.
a: Traffic today is worse than yesterday.

Which is the ___ city you've ever visited?

a: He is taller than his brother.

a: The new layout is far more efficient than the old one.

items.q: My flat is ___ small as yours.

title: 13. Количество: much, many, few, little, some, any
intro: **many / few / a few** — с исчисляемыми (_people, drawings_); **much / little / a little** — с неисчисляемыми (_time, money, information_).
**a few / a little** — немного, достаточно; **few / little** — мало, почти нет.
**a lot of / lots of** — с любыми; в утверждениях естественнее, чем much / many.
**some** — в утверждениях и просьбах, **any** — в вопросах и отрицаниях.
⚠ Неисчисляемые, которые хочется посчитать: _information, advice, equipment, furniture, news, research, feedback, accommodation, traffic_ — без -s и без a.

items.q: How ___ time do we have?
How ___ drawings are left?

Can you give me a piece of advice?

items.q: I have ___ friends in Tbilisi, so I'm not lonely.

a: We need more information about the site.

a: The furniture in the office is new.

title: 14. Мелкие правила: предлоги, артикли, формы
intro: **on time** — вовремя; **in time** — успеть впритык.
**look forward to + -ing**: _to_ здесь предлог — _looking forward to seeing you_. Так же **way of + -ing**, **responsible for + -ing**, **proud of + -ing**.
Отрицание прилагательных — **un-**: _unfriendly, unhappy_; **non-** — для существительных и категорий: _non-smoker, non-fiction_; но _non-existent_.
Существительное-определение — в **ед. числе**: _apartment block, three-bedroom flat, five-star hotel, ten-minute walk_.
После **no** не нужен _did_: _No setbacks stopped me_.
Предлоги из диагностики: _arrive **at** the airport / **in** a city, married **to**, responsible **for**, depend **on**, good **at**_.

items.x: Стандартная концовка письма: We look forward to hearing from you.

title: Работа: роль, сочетания, фразовые
intro: Учим не отдельные слова, а **готовые блоки**: _meet a deadline, take on a project_. В скобках — подсказка по-русски.
Роль: **be in charge of · be responsible for + -ing · oversee · my role involves + -ing**.
Сочетания: **meet a deadline · take on a project · carry out a task · give a presentation · gain experience · make progress · take the lead on · set a goal**.
Фразовые: **take on · carry out · come up with · deal with · sort out · catch up on · set up**.

intro: Первые 8 заданий на уроке остались без ответа — сейчас самое время.
Сильные стороны: **One of my key strengths is… · a strong background in · proficient in · a knack for · detail-oriented, proactive, adaptable, reliable**.
Достижения: **accomplish a goal · be proud of + -ing · exceed expectations · deliver on time · land a contract · get promoted to**.
Трудности: **face a challenge · overcome an obstacle · a steep learning curve · work to a tight deadline · juggle · a setback · inherit a model**.

items.x: One of my key strengths is…

title: Дорога и быт: фразовые глаголы
intro: Дорога: **set off · head for · stop over · check in / out · get around · show around · end up · come across**.
Быт: **look forward to + -ing · catch up with · hang out with · get away · figure out · pick up / drop off**.

⚠ _set off_ ≠ _stop over_ ≠ _step over_ (перешагнуть).

items.q: We ___ (отправились) at dawn to avoid the traffic.

title: Связки для Writing
intro: **Добавить**: _Furthermore, Moreover, In addition, Not only… but also_.
**Противопоставить**: _However, Nevertheless, On the other hand, whereas, although, despite_.
**Причина и следствие**: _because of, due to, As a result, Therefore, Consequently_.
**Пример**: _For example, For instance, such as_. **Итог**: _In conclusion, Overall, To sum up_. **Мнение**: _In my opinion, I strongly believe that, It could be argued that_.
